title: Phased GPO-to-Intune Transition Program & Sequencing Roadmap
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (program-level orchestration of a sequenced GPO-to-Intune transition: core OS first, then security controls; conflict/loop governance, coexistence, multi-workstream).
Complements group-policy-to-intune-settings-migration (mechanics) by providing the strategy/sequencing/governance layer. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Do it right: a sequenced GPO-to-Intune transition that stabilizes the foundation before touching security
problem: The fastest way to break a GPO-to-Intune transition is to migrate security controls (firewall, app control) before the foundation is clean — conflicts, loops, and lockouts follow. This solution is the program and sequencing roadmap for doing it right: migrate core OS settings first, stabilize, then layer in security controls in a deliberate order, with coexistence governance (MDM-wins-over-GP), conflict/loop guardrails, go/no-go gates, and an operating model — so internal pressure to rush doesn't wreck the move.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the phased transition model (rationalize → core OS → stabilize → security controls → app control), coexistence and precedence (MDM wins over GP), conflict/loop governance, and the program operating model with go/no-go gates.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a rationalized GPO backlog, Group Policy analytics, stakeholder alignment, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define phases and sequencing, set coexistence/precedence guardrails, run the core-OS phase, stabilize and validate, sequence the security-control phases (firewall, app control) with go/no-go gates, then expand and decommission GPO scope.

5 PowerShell scripts — transition-readiness discovery, per-phase coexistence/conflict validation, a phase-status and conflict report, safe remediation of precedence conflicts, and a phase/wave scope-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The program and sequencing roadmap for a GPO-to-Intune transition done right — core OS first, then security controls, with coexistence governance, conflict/loop guardrails, and go/no-go gates. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
